outcome: Neuron density in frontal cortex and cerebellum
cohort: The study participants were fetal lambs with experimentally induced spina bifida aperta, divided into groups receiving either 2-port or 3-port fetoscopic repair, and unoperated littermates served as controls.
finding: Despite the 2-port repair taking significantly longer than the 3-port repair, there were no relevant morphologic differences in the fetal brain between the two repair techniques in the experimental spina bifida fetal lamb model.
mod_finding: All surviving fetuses were delivered by cesarean delivery at 143 days of gestation.
gest_age: Fetal lambs underwent surgery at 100 days of gestation and were delivered and examined at 143 days of gestation (term: 145 days).
